title: Search, filters and sort work the same way on the Inactive tab
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-FILT-01, description "ZZAUTOTEST PL filter Alpha") is active at {Location-A}, in category {Category-A} (for example the first category offered).
  • Inventory part {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-FILT-02, description "ZZAUTOTEST PL filter Bravo") is active, in category {Category-B} (for example the second category offered).
  • Inventory part {Part-C} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-FILT-03, description "ZZAUTOTEST PL filter Charlie") is inactive, in {Category-A}.
  • Inventory part {Part-D} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-FILT-04, description "ZZAUTOTEST PL filter Delta") is inactive, in {Category-B}.
  • The four descriptions sort Alpha, Bravo, Charlie, Delta, and all four part numbers start with {Prefix-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-FILT).
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  2. Type {Prefix-A} in the Search box.
  3. Open the Category filter and pick {Category-A}.
  4. Open the Category filter and pick All categories.
  5. Click the Description column header.
  6. Click the Description column header again.
  7. Click the Inactive tab.
  8. Type {Prefix-A} in the Search box, replacing any text there.
  9. Open the Category filter and pick {Category-A}.
  10. Open the Category filter and pick All categories.
  11. Click the Description column header.
  12. Click the Description column header again.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: The Active tab lists {Part-A} and {Part-B}: 2 rows.
  • Step 3: Only {Part-A} is listed (1 row).
  • Step 4: {Part-A} and {Part-B} are listed again.
  • Steps 5 and 6: The list is sorted by Description, and the second click reverses the order ({Part-A} above {Part-B} one way, {Part-B} above {Part-A} the other).
  • Step 8: The Inactive tab lists {Part-C} and {Part-D}: 2 rows.
  • Step 9: Only {Part-C} is listed (1 row), just as the same filter left only the {Category-A} part on the Active tab.
  • Step 10: {Part-C} and {Part-D} are listed again.
  • Steps 11 and 12: The list is sorted by Description and the second click reverses it ({Part-C} above {Part-D}, then {Part-D} above {Part-C}), the same behaviour as on the Active tab.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10814 (Story 1, Active and Inactive Tabs on the Inventory List); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S1-R7, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 3.5 (The Inactive tab), board 4.10 (Branch: no inactive parts), 13 Oct copy.
